source_title: 와뉴비 다들 왜 사제 안키우는 지 알거같다
subtitle: 주특입 8바퀴 만에 깨달은 천 경쟁의 현실

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
수도원 주특입 파티!
치유 템 꼭 먹고 가요!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle three-quarter shot of cute 2.5-head chibi SD girls on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, the Night Elf Priest cheerfully raises one finger with her cross staff stowed on her back and clean empty hands. On the right, the Troll Shaman listens casually with dual hand-axes holstered at her waist beside a small wooden Scarlet Monastery sign.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
주문력에 정신력?
고술도 쓰는 옵 맞지~?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the shocked Night Elf Priest in the left foreground facing the Troll Shaman on the right in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. With her axes stowed, the Troll Shaman happily holds up a white-and-gold cloth chapeau in one hand and a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold die showing round dot pips only (no digits) in the other.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 마법 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 최대 18만큼 증가합니다.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
어? 몰라서 이미 꼈어!
미안미안~ 수고해!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle side-view shot of cute 2.5-head chibi SD girls on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone tile shadow. On the right, the Orc Warrior turns to leave while waving awkwardly, gripping the glowing golden healer mace Scepter of the Librarian in one hand and a sturdy round shield on her other arm with her basic sword stowed. On the left, the Night Elf Priest leans forward staring in disbelief with empty hands.

Extreme close-up bust shot filling 80 percent of the frame height of the Night Elf Priest dead-center in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Her face is pale and soul-crushed with wide blank saucer eyes, a twitching frozen polite smile, and comical dark vertical gloom lines behind her head.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
여덟 바퀴째라면서.
난 양보할게, 너 먹어.
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile medium shot of cute 2.5-head chibi SD girls on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, the exhausted Night Elf Priest with dark under-eye circles clasps her empty hands pleadingly with her staff stowed. On the right, the sleepy-eyed Undead Paladin with her golden tank shield and one-handed mace stowed at her back calmly flicks a dot-pipped pass-roll die away toward the Priest.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
진짜 고마워요 보기님!
근데 천 경쟁 실화예요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter close-up shot of cute 2.5-head chibi SD girls on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, the Night Elf Priest hugs the glowing Scepter of the Librarian tightly to her chest with glistening comic tears of joy and her cross staff stowed on her back. On the right, the Undead Paladin watches deadpan with half-lidded eyes, arms crossed, and her shield and mace stowed.
